messages.content: Explain what a Python function is. Use exactly 3 bullet points. Do not include any code.

• A function is a reusable block of code that runs when called.
• You define it with `def` and can pass values in as arguments.
• It can return a result to the caller with `return`.
List two common Python exception types and when they occur. JSON only, keys: exceptions (array of {name, when}).
{"exceptions": [{"name": "ValueError", "when": "Invalid value for conversion or operation"}, {"name": "TypeError", "when": "Operation on an incompatible type"}]}
What does try/except do? Answer in one short paragraph, max 50 words.
try/except runs code that might fail; if an exception occurs, Python jumps to except so the program can handle the error instead of crashing.
Describe list comprehensions in 2 bullets only. No code blocks.

• A list comprehension builds a new list from an iterable in one expression.
• You can add an optional if filter: [x for x in items if condition].
Reply with the single word yes or no only: Can a module be both imported and run as a script?
